entities.name: John XI of Constantinople
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John XI Bekkos was Patriarch of Constantinople from 2 June 1275 to 26 December 1282, and the chief Greek advocate, in Byzantine times, of the reunion of the Eastern Orthodox and Roman Catholic Churches.
